inputs: Claim's assumed comparable entry valuation: USD 1.25 trillion
Claim's proposed exit valuations: USD 1.5 trillion and USD 2 trillion
Illustrative assumptions only: unchanged ownership, comparable valuation bases, no fees or preferences
derived.formula: Hypothetical gross gain = exit valuation / entry valuation - 1. Thus 1.5 / 1.25 - 1 = 20%, and 2 / 1.25 - 1 = 60%. Under these assumptions, any comparable exit valuation above 1.25 gives a positive gain.
derived.rounding: Exact percentages; these are illustrative calculations, not observed investor returns.
